name: lfm2-gqa-only-tts-benchmark_metrics
description: A benchmark collection of objective and subjective metrics for text-to-speech (TTS) systems, focused on evaluating generated-speech quality, intelligibility, and prosody. It provides reference scores (e.g., MOS) and auxiliary objective measures (e.g., CER/WER, MCD) to compare TTS models and vocoders. The dataset is intended for both automatic metric evaluation and human listening tests.
evaluation_method: human_eval (MOS) and objective metrics (CER/WER, MCD, prosody metrics)
reputation: A niche TTS-focused benchmark used by researchers working on speech synthesis and evaluation; modest adoption beyond that community.
